author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The current hand off from the testing phase to the serving endpoint is entirely manual. Every time we validate a new model, an engineer has to log in and click the deploy button. I want that transition to fire automatically once the tests pass. The more automated this step becomes, the better it is for the team. I would love to see the pipeline trigger the serving update without any human intervention at all. Removing that manual bottleneck is the priority for me right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the level of automation makes the team happier and identifies removing the manual bottleneck as their top priority, indicating that exceeding the baseline request for automation would be preferred.
